title: Cybersecurity Roadmap 2025: Zero to $95k Without a Degree
short_hook: Your exact path to a cybersecurity job in 2025
description:
Searching for a cybersecurity roadmap 2025? This video lays out the exact 5-step path from zero to a high-paying job this year, without needing a university degree. We cover the essential foundations every aspiring professional needs. In this video: 1. Why networking fundamentals and subnetting are non-negotiable baselines for 2025 roles. 2. How to master Linux administration using free virtual machines and tools like OWASP and TryHackMe. 3. The core skills for web applications and APIs, including HTTP methods and status codes. 4. Why understanding the protocol beats relying on tools like Burp Suite. 5. The critical mindset shift from theory to hands-on practice. Stop wasting months on theory employers don't value. Start your journey today. In this video we laid out the exact five-step path from zero to a ninety-five thousand dollar salary this year, and we are going to skip the degree trap entirely. By the end, you will have a concrete action plan you can start today.
